response.rationale: The presence of 'brownish macules on the hands and feet' and 'onychodystrophy' are highly specific to Peutz-Jeghers Syndrome (D6) and are explicitly listed as support items. D7 (Juvenile Polyposis Syndrome) is contradicted by the absence of these findings.
